title: Human Digital Twin — Body-State Model x(t)
description: The twin as a digital STATE MODEL of a human body: the live estimated state x(t) of organ-compartment sub-systems, kept synchronized to the physical person by state estimation, plus the DYNAMICAL MODEL that evolves x(t)->x(t+1) (the 'model representation'). A stored state is not a twin; the dynamical model makes it predictive. Because x(t) and its predictions are dispositive personal data that may cross a boundary (clinician export, agent delegation, actuation), every instance carries an Ω readiness state and the Human Protection Envelope — validity is not permission.

twin_id.description: stable id of this body twin instance

profile_id.description: the physical person this twin models

as_of.description: the instant x(t) is estimated for

omega_state.description: readiness of this state/prediction to cross a boundary (Ω lattice, human-protection-envelope.json)

compartments.description: organ-compartment state vectors (cardio, metabolic, immune, neuro, ...); each is a piece of x(t)

variables.description: the state variables of this compartment, each with an estimate and its uncertainty

estimate_sd.description: posterior std-dev from state estimation (uncertainty is first-class)

fhir_code.description: optional LOINC/FHIR Observation code for interoperability

state_estimation.description: how x(t) is synchronized to the physical body from sensor streams

sensor_refs.description: consented sensor/observation sources fused into this estimate (biometrics, HRV, kinematics, labs, wearables, EHR)

innovation_norm.description: residual between prediction and latest observation; a large innovation flags model/sensor divergence

dynamical_model.description: THE MODEL REPRESENTATION — the model that evolves x(t)->x(t+1). Hybrid by design: a mechanistic backbone (verified compute) plus a learned surrogate (the personal residual), reconciled by the gate.

mechanistic.description: physiology ODEs / PK-PD / compartment dynamics — explicit, interpretable, verifiable

verified_compute.description: true iff the forward step was executed under the verified-compute gate (not a free-text guess)

learned.description: data-driven surrogate for what the equations miss; distilled from the person's own consented history (never generic web data, never model-of-model slop)

weights_sbom_ref.description: attestation/SBOM entry for the served weights (model-governance-ledger)

trained_on.description: provenance class of the training data

reconciliation.description: how the learned proposal and the mechanistic step were reconciled by the gate. learned proposes, physics disposes: 'learned_only'/'divergent' MUST NOT drive human actuation.

prediction.description: optional forward run of the dynamical model (what-if / risk / forecast)

target.description: which state variable(s) the prediction is about

protection.description: the Human Protection Envelope for this state/prediction — consent, privacy, physical/cognitive safety, policy decision, provenance. Reused, not re-specified.

allOf.$comment: Safety gate: a state whose forward model was learned-only or divergent (physics did not verify it) must not be exportable-as-actionable and must not drive human actuation.
Ω promotion floor: an ACTIONABLE/DELIVERED body state requires present consent and an allow policy decision (validity is not permission).
